## How this portfolio works

Each project has its own page in [`projects/`](projects/) with:

- A plain-language problem and solution writeup
- Key decisions and trade-offs
- A demo pitch: what I'd say to show it off

Hero images live in [`assets/<slug>/`](assets/).

The index above is generated from each page's frontmatter. After adding or editing a page, run:

```bash
python tools/build_portfolio.py          # rebuild the index and any missing hero cards
python tools/build_portfolio.py --check  # exit 1 if anything is out of date
```

## About

I build small, focused AI workflows that take friction out of real work:
meetings, notes, admin, research, trade paperwork. Each project is designed for its user first,
not as a technical showcase. If one of these looks useful for what you're doing,
reach out.
